what: SVG lettering strokes draw in with a hand-drawn tremble — while the stroke (dashoffset) draws over 1.5s linear, the stroke color fills in, and for 1.8s four turbulence displacement filters switch every 10% so the line wobbles and then settles, the fill paints in over 1.6s, starting 1.4s after the stroke starts. Each line is .3s later. The outline type does not fill its interior (outlined English title)

options.[data-fx-part=text]: SVG to Draw <text>(child, one per line) — stroke length is measured as text length × 1.6
options.on: load (default — immediately on attach) · view (when 20% is visible) · state (when the calling side adds is-in)
options.look: outline: Leave only the outline without filling the inside
options.--fx-dash: Stroke length (via style), default 1.5s — original sub-section 1.3s
options.--fx-fill-at: From stroke start to fill (via style), default 1.4s — original subsection 1.2s
